QuestInfo.name: [Erel Light] For Those Who Wait
QuestInfo.0: A letter from #p9201720# has arrived. What kind of news could be inside?
QuestInfo.1: You're not the only one fighting for the light. You must become stronger--strong enough to stand against any darkness.
QuestInfo.2: You realized that you're not the only one fighting for the light. You resolved to become stronger still--strong enough to stand against any darkness.
